title: Amazingly Dense Canadian Myeolchi Anchovies Fried Rice
description: A dense and flavorful Canadian dish featuring myeolchi anchovies, double fry KFC style, and plant based friendly, cooked on a salt block vessel.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double fry the myeolchi anchovies by frying them for 2 minutes, then letting them cool, and frying them again for 1 minute until crispy.
In the same skillet, add the diced onion and cook until translucent for 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula, and stir fry for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the rice mixture and stir fry for 1 minute until well combined.
Add the double fried myeolchi anchovies to the rice mixture and stir fry for 1 minute until well combined.
Transfer the rice mixture to a salt block vessel and cook for 2 minutes on each side until a crust forms.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
